caption: Acceptance Criteria and Verification Outcomes for the Coupled Model
rows: Hydrogen used for heat is not counted twice
Combustion emissions counted once at the shared gas bus
Below 1e-6 MW at every bus and snapshot
Approximately 3e-12 MW after the validator fix
Snapshot weights sum to the hours in the year
Infeasible or non-optimal never reported as success
Every input carries a provenance record and a hash
notes: The bus-balance criterion could not be met by any real-sized solve before 2026-09-30: the diagnostic called PyPSA's energy_balance() without an explicit round argument and so inherited a global default of five decimal places, coarser than the 1e-6 MW criterion it was testing against. Passing round=12 exposed the true residual.
source: Source: model test suite and scenario artifacts.
